document_description: Read `.claude/commands/eap-branch.md` for the full workflow. Always ask about ADO story alignment before creating a branch. Follow naming conventions: `feature/`, `fix/`, `refactor/`, `docs/`, `chore/`. Include `AB#<id>` in branch name when an ADO story is linked. Never delete `main` or the current branch without confirmation.
